audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Aegis Assault his PASSIVE in four places ('his passive Aegis Assault blocks repeated autos', 'his passive Aegis stacks are down') and describes E as a shred. It also asserts an execute: 'Q refunds on low-HP targets', 'Execute you below roughly 15% HP with his empowered Q passive'.
audit.why: Mortal Will (P) is the passive — every few spells or attacks his next spell is empowered. Aegis Assault (E, 22/21/20/19/18s, 400 range) is a channel that makes him invulnerable to damage FROM THE FRONT while he strikes; it shreds nothing and it is not a stack meter. Nothing in Riot's description supports a health-threshold execute or a low-HP cooldown refund on Comet Spear, so that advice was steering the player off a fact that is not in the data.
audit.corrected: Passive credited to Mortal Will; Aegis Assault described as front-facing invulnerability to walk around rather than spend a combo into; the execute claim removed rather than replaced with a guess.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown appeared anywhere despite every line saying 'track Shield Vault'.
audit.why: Shield Vault is 13/12/11/10/9 at 600 range, Comet Spear 11/10.25/9.5/8.75/8 at 575, Aegis Assault 22-18s, Grand Starfall 180/165/150. The 13-second Shield Vault is the timer the whole lane runs on, and Aegis Assault's 22 seconds is the longest gap in his kit.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into early, mid, whys[3], spikes[1] and wants.you[1].

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Pantheon four stages and Sion none while Sion wins 52.38%, and it does not match the packet chart (Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Pantheon, Skill, Skill, Sion).
audit.why: Both layers currently agree with each other, and the mirror audit explicitly left its chart as found and flagged it. Flipping four rows unilaterally here would put the two directions in conflict on a chart nobody has adjudicated.
audit.corrected: Left as found and raised as a question — see questionsForUser.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing told the player that Shield Vault resets his auto-attack.
audit.why: The wind-up on the reset auto, not the ability cast, is the visible cue that the burst has started — that is when Soul Furnace goes up.

edits.before: Pantheon's passive Aegis Assault blocks repeated autos and his W stun is instant — your Q charge animation is visible and he punishes it freely at level 1.
edits.after: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few actions, and Shield Vault is a dash-stun — your Q charge animation is visible and he punishes it freely at level 1.

edits.before: With all three basic abilities he can W-stun into empowered Q into E shred in one smooth rotation — your W-shield absorbs the burst but you have no reliable answer to the stun startup.
edits.after: With all three basics he chains Shield Vault's stun into an empowered Comet Spear and hides behind Aegis Assault — Soul Furnace eats the burst but nothing answers the stun startup.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are his sustained bullying peak: Q refunds on low-HP targets and repeated empowered pokes keep you reactive; you lack a meaningful spike to trade back.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are his bullying peak: Comet Spear is down to 9s and Mortal Will keeps arriving, so repeated empowered pokes keep you reactive with no spike to trade back.

edits.before: Pantheon's empowered Q poke and point-click W stun dictate early trades — his passive Aegis Assault blocks all your auto-enhanced autos while he harasses freely.
edits.after: Empowered Comet Spear and a point-click Shield Vault dictate early trades — Aegis Assault (his E) then blocks damage from the front while he harasses freely.

edits.before: Pantheon peaks here with Q refunds on low-HP targets; stay above execute threshold or a single empowered Q finishes you under your own tower.
edits.after: Pantheon peaks here: Comet Spear at 9s plus Mortal Will means constant empowered poke — stay high on HP or he chunks you under your own tower.

edits.before: Pantheon comes out of the gates hitting hard: his passive Aegis Assault blocks consecutive autos, his W (Shield Vault) is a point-click stun that costs him nothing to activate, and each empowered Q (Comet Spear) poke can be spent at will from his stacking passive. Do not charge your Q in the open — he reads the animation and walks out, then Shield Vault-stuns you mid-channel for a free trade. Instead, stay at wave-tip range, take Doran's Shield, pop W-shield the instant he Shield Vaults to absorb his burst, and look for a quick charged Q trade only when his passive Aegis stacks are down (listen for the shield-break sound).
edits.after: Pantheon comes out of the gates hitting hard: Mortal Will empowers his next spell every few actions, Shield Vault (W) is a point-click dash-stun on 13 seconds at rank 1 that also resets his auto-attack, and Comet Spear (Q) pokes every 11. Do not charge your Q in the open — he reads the animation and walks out, then Shield Vaults you mid-channel for a free trade. Stay at wave-tip range, take Doran's Shield, and pop W the instant his auto winds up rather than when the ability lights up, because that reset is the real start of his burst. Trade back only once Shield Vault is spent.

edits.before: Levels 4 and 5 are Pantheon's sustained pressure window: his Q poke refreshes passives quickly, and if he gets you below the execute threshold his empowered Q deletes you under tower. Keep your HP above 40%, burn W-shield proactively to stay healthy, and be patient — your charged Q's long range means you can threaten him from outside his W dash range whenever he steps up to last-hit. At level 6 both kits change simultaneously: his Grand Starfall threatens the map but he loses lane priority to roam, so track his recall timer, shove the wave on his rotation, and consider matching his roam with Unstoppable Onslaught across the river if your jungler can convert.
edits.after: Levels 4 and 5 are Pantheon's sustained pressure window: Comet Spear returns every 9-11 seconds and Mortal Will keeps empowering it, so he chips you for free. Keep your HP above 40%, burn W-shield proactively to stay healthy, and be patient — your charged Q outranges his 600-unit Shield Vault whenever he steps up to last-hit. Never dump a combo into Aegis Assault: it blocks damage from the front for the whole channel, so walk around it or wait it out. At level 6 his Grand Starfall (180s at rank 1) threatens the map but costs him lane priority, so track his recall timer, shove on his rotation, and match the roam with Unstoppable Onslaught if your jungler can convert.

edits.after: Land the fully charged Q knockup once Shield Vault is spent — 13 seconds at rank 1 with no dash to answer

notes: The packet suspectName 'Shield Vaults' is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name used as a verb. NOT ASSERTED, and the previous text was wrong to assert it: Pantheon has no verified health-threshold execute or low-HP Comet Spear refund in Riot's description, so I removed the claim rather than swap in a number I cannot verify. Also left unstated: whether a charged Decimating Smash knock-up interrupts the Aegis Assault channel — the kit carries both a 'channel: interruptible' flag and text saying he is invulnerable from the front, and Riot's own wording does not settle it; the advice is to walk around the channel, which is safe either way.
